evidence.evidence_text: In this paper, we propose MAGIC, a new multi-aspect controllable text generation method with disentangled counterfactual augmentation.
Multi-aspect controllable text generation aims to control the generated texts in attributes from multiple aspects (e.g., “positive” from sentiment and “sport” from topic).
